title: Open-Meteo Weather Forecasts
description: Pulls 7-day forecast data from Open-Meteo for cities that map to Kalshi weather contracts: NYC, LA, Chicago, Miami, Houston, Phoenix. Captures daily high/low temps (Fahrenheit), precipitation, wind speed, and weather codes. Professional models update every 6 hours; Kalshi weather markets are thin and lag model updates by hours or days. Direct edge on weather contracts.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

LOC_NAMES = ['New York City', 'Los Angeles', 'Chicago', 'Miami', 'Houston', 'Phoenix']
LOC_LATS = [40.71, 34.05, 41.88, 25.76, 29.76, 33.45]
LOC_LONS = [-74.01, -118.24, -87.63, -80.19, -95.37, -112.07]

WEATHER_CODES = {
    0: 'Clear sky', 1: 'Mainly clear', 2: 'Partly cloudy', 3: 'Overcast',
    45: 'Fog', 48: 'Depositing rime fog',
    51: 'Light drizzle', 53: 'Moderate drizzle', 55: 'Dense drizzle',
    61: 'Slight rain', 63: 'Moderate rain', 65: 'Heavy rain',
    66: 'Light freezing rain', 67: 'Heavy freezing rain',
    71: 'Slight snow', 73: 'Moderate snow', 75: 'Heavy snow', 77: 'Snow grains',
    80: 'Slight rain showers', 81: 'Moderate rain showers', 82: 'Violent rain showers',
    85: 'Slight snow showers', 86: 'Heavy snow showers',
    95: 'Thunderstorm', 96: 'Thunderstorm w/ slight hail', 99: 'Thunderstorm w/ heavy hail',
}

rows = []

for loc_idx in range(len(LOC_NAMES)):
    loc_name = LOC_NAMES[loc_idx]
    lat = LOC_LATS[loc_idx]
    lon = LOC_LONS[loc_idx]
    try:
        resp = requests.get(
            'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast',
            params={
                'latitude': lat,
                'longitude': lon,
                'daily': 'temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_sum,wind_speed_10m_max,weather_code',
                'temperature_unit': 'fahrenheit',
                'wind_speed_unit': 'mph',
                'precipitation_unit': 'mm',
                'timezone': 'auto',
                'forecast_days': 7,
            },
            timeout=30,
        )
        if resp.status_code == 429:
            time.sleep(5)
            resp = requests.get(
                'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast',
                params={
                    'latitude': lat,
                    'longitude': lon,
                    'daily': 'temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_sum,wind_speed_10m_max,weather_code',
                    'temperature_unit': 'fahrenheit',
                    'wind_speed_unit': 'mph',
                    'precipitation_unit': 'mm',
                    'timezone': 'auto',
                    'forecast_days': 7,
                },
                timeout=30,
            )
        resp.raise_for_status()
    except Exception:
        continue
    data = resp.json()
    daily = data.get('daily', {})
    dates = daily.get('time', [])
    t_max = daily.get('temperature_2m_max', [])
    t_min = daily.get('temperature_2m_min', [])
    precip = daily.get('precipitation_sum', [])
    wind = daily.get('wind_speed_10m_max', [])
    codes = daily.get('weather_code', [])
    for i in range(len(dates)):
        wc = int(codes[i]) if i < len(codes) and codes[i] is not None else 0
        rows.append({
            'location_name': loc_name,
            'latitude': lat,
            'longitude': lon,
            'forecast_date': dates[i],
            'temp_max_f': round(t_max[i], 1) if i < len(t_max) and t_max[i] is not None else None,
            'temp_min_f': round(t_min[i], 1) if i < len(t_min) and t_min[i] is not None else None,
            'precipitation_mm': round(precip[i], 1) if i < len(precip) and precip[i] is not None else 0.0,
            'wind_speed_max_mph': round(wind[i], 1) if i < len(wind) and wind[i] is not None else None,
            'weather_code': wc,
            'weather_description': WEATHER_CODES.get(wc, 'Unknown'),
            'forecast_model': 'open-meteo-auto',
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })
    time.sleep(0.3)

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
